nodes.summary: Split storyboard validation into deterministic schema checks and LLM-assisted repair loops
nodes.decision: Split storyboard validation into deterministic schema checks and LLM-assisted repair loops
nodes.why: Single-pass validation hid recurring panel continuity failures until export time. The split gives weekly reporting a clear reliability story and gives future debugging a stable contract boundary.
nodes.impact: Weekly reporting can explain the reliability improvement without re-reading implementation commits.
inference_notes: Decision content inferred from summary/context because explicit decision fields were sparse.

nodes.summary: Kept panel layout generation separate from dialogue generation to preserve independent retry boundaries
nodes.decision: Kept panel layout generation separate from dialogue generation to preserve independent retry boundaries
nodes.why: Combining both stages made repair cheaper in the happy path but caused dialogue rewrites during layout-only failures. Separate contracts trade a small orchestration cost for more predictable retries.
nodes.chosen: Kept panel layout generation separate from dialogue generation to preserve independent retry boundaries
nodes.impact: Architecture docs now preserve the retry-boundary decision for future stage changes.

nodes.decision: Kept validation repair loops inside the validation stage while preserving orchestration-level retry boundaries

nodes.chosen: Kept validation repair loops inside the validation stage while preserving orchestration-level retry boundaries
